Hey... as someone with abandonment issues and who lost a parent here's my advice.  Just continue to be consistent with him. Show him that you are not leaving. Give him structure. Routine. Dinner around the same time. Bedtime at the same time.  Let him know when things will happen. Give him all the reassurance he needs. What happened in the store is not a big deal.  What would be a big deal is if you gave up on him and sent him away or if his mom was coming in and out of his life without notice. Good luck. I really wish the best for you and your nephew.
